candidates.hook: Loud, violent pounding on the wooden double doors bursts in.
candidates.cliffhanger: Lady Catherine demands “Show me your hand,” but we never see what Juliana will reveal.
candidates.why: Combines a sudden, shocking intrusion with a tense accusation, ending on a question that forces viewers to watch the next episode.

candidates.hook: The Dowager Duchess gasps, “That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest.”
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana’s eyes widen in stunned revelation, cutting before she can answer the implication about her husband.
candidates.why: A high‑stakes family secret is exposed, leaving the audience hanging on Juliana’s next words.

candidates.hook: Blond Nobleman coldly commands, “Girl. Show me what you are holding.”
candidates.cliffhanger: Lady Catherine’s accusation, “Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?” hangs unresolved.
candidates.why: Shows the power struggle and accusation, ending on a question that begs resolution.

moments.desc: Loud pounding on the double doors signals a sudden intrusion.
Duchess reveals the ring bears the Ashbourne crest, a family secret.
Lady Catherine accuses Juliana of poisoning the Duchess, shouting the lie.
Guard seizes Juliana, dragging her away as she looks terrified.
